kpis_story.description_fr: Cession yogurt NA (Yoplait, Liberté) annoncée 2024 à Lactalis/Sodiaal. Recentrage portefeuille haute marge (céréales, pet, snacks).
kpis_story.description_en: NA yogurt divestiture (Yoplait, Liberté) announced 2024 to Lactalis/Sodiaal. Portfolio refocus on higher-margin categories (cereal, pet, snacks).

_notes: General Mills CPG food, fiscal year mai. Pet = catalyst post-acquisition Blue Buffalo.
